From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Brown <sofia.brown@carepath.com>, Evan Li <evan.li@carepath.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Decision authority inventory + SLA exception request — CarePath pilot

Thanks for the call this morning — quick recap and next steps from my side:

- Goal: 6-week pilot (data subset) to validate inference latency and cost profile for CarePath’s triage flows.
- Action items for CarePath: confirm final stakeholder roster, procurement contact, and any mandatory security attachments.
- RedFlag: procurement has flagged SLA terms around PII retention and availability. They indicated this may require a formal exception.

Two asks from CarePath so we can move forward this week:
1) Please add a single roster CSV with names, roles, and approval authority (who can sign procurement/contract and who signs technical acceptance). A sample header is fine.
2) If procurement requires an SLA deviation, can you confirm the specific clause they want changed or a target SLO (e.g., 99.5% monthly uptime vs. our standard 99.9%)?

Monica / Ben — looping you in to start an internal exception path if needed. If procurement asks for a discount tied to availability, flag it here and I’ll route for approval.

Attachments: Proposed_SLA_Redwood_v1.pdf (proposal for pilot SLOs)

--
Michael Grant
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

Thanks, Michael — great summary. Quick responses inline:

- Roster: attaching our preliminary procurement/decision roster (small CSV) — includes who can sign (Legal head) and who approves success criteria (Product VP).
- SLA ask: Procurement is asking whether we can soften the downtime penalty language for the pilot (they want a 99.5% SLO and no financial penalty for the pilot period). They also requested details on data retention and log access for audits.

I've attached the procurement roster and the security questionnaire excerpt they mentioned. Evan (security), can you confirm whether the current Redwood audit log cadence is sufficient?

Attachments: CarePath_Procurement_Roster.csv (csv); CarePath_Security_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 13:45:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Decision authority inventory + SLA exception request — CarePath pilot

Thanks for the context — reviewed the roster and checklist. Procurement wants two things that will require internal sign-off:

1) Temporary SLO change for pilot: CarePath is asking to reduce monthly availability SLO to 99.5% and to waive financial penalties for the pilot period.
2) Data retention: they want a 90-day log retention window and access to audit logs on request. Our standard pilot offering is 30-day retention and on-request logs only for security reviews.

Recommendation: We can grant a 99.5% SLO for the 6-week pilot with no monetary penalties if they sign an explicit pilot addendum and accept a limited warranty; we should keep 60-day log retention (compromise) rather than 90 days. Procurement discount: none by default — Ben, would you consider a token credit (one-month usage credit) if Legal signs the addendum?

I’ve attached a short internal memo template you can use to route the approval to Legal & Finance. If you want, I can take point on the internal approval ticket and escalate to Ops for the retention change.

Attachments: internal_exception_memo_template.txt (txt)

--
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 15:37:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Decision authority inventory + SLA exception request — CarePath pilot

OK — sounds reasonable. Approved path below: 

- Accept 99.5% SLO for the six-week pilot with NO financial penalties (pilot addendum required).
- Approve 60-day log retention for the pilot. Ops to confirm feasibility; Monica to open ticket with infra.
- Offer a one-month usage credit as a courtesy (not a negotiated discount) contingent on a signed pilot addendum and DocuSign completion.

Michael — please send the addendum draft to Sofia and procurement@carepath.com. Include: explicit pilot dates, SLO (99.5%), retention terms (60-day), and the one-month usage credit clause. I'll loop in Legal if they push for more.
